required_abstention: Do not convert slave export into territorial slavery prevalence, assume that exported people were enslaved within Lazica, or back-project Procopius's sixth-century description to an exact 500 CE selected-year state without independent temporal support.
evidence_locus: Lazican/Colchian Black Sea commerce described by Procopius and specialist analysis
inference_extent: external/network participation in sixth-century slave export; no 500 CE territorial-practice claim
temporal_display_rule: Sixth-century Lazican slave-export evidence does not establish exact 500 CE selected-year truth.
network_territorial_note: The decisive direct evidence is trade/export participation. It is intentionally not converted into territorial practice or prevalence.
